mentions.name: Container Tracker
mentions.description: A Google Sheets add-on that automates the process of tracking ocean shipping containers, live on the Google Workspace Marketplace, with the main workload handled by a backend of serverless functions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m interested in ocean container shipping, so I built a Google Sheets add-on to automate the process of tracking shipping containers. It’s called Container Tracker and I just got it live on the Google Marketplace.
